title: feat(workflows): link the sending allowance card to the tier docs

session.source: t3code (claudeAgent provider; transcript is the Claude Code JSONL)
session.title: Document sending allowance tiers

taskStatement:
![image.png](t3-context://v1/image/image_5446a446-d842-43fd-9d07-7e9142f3fe9c) 
Can you check if there are docs for the actual sending tiers? The allowance tier is set to tier 07, but I can't find any link here that explains these tiers. They're only in code or internal docs.
Give me a quick link to PostHog.com. Pull it down. I think the docs should live there. Clone it in my dev dir, then add a description of the tiers and a link here in the actual UI that says what the tiers are.

Additionally, in the actual product, add a question mark icon behind the tier badge in line, and then add a styled hover there for the actual tiers with a link in the hover. Additionally, that goes to the docs, so users can quickly look up the tiers on the actual page.

The tooltip seems not well formatted. Make sure it uses the card design system and tokens and so on. At least in the screenshot, it's black against white. Doesn't seem correct
whyChosen: A full-stack slice inside the workflows product that must choose where tier data lives: the backend serializer exposes every tier's caps, the generated API types and MCP client follow, and the UI renders a popover card.
